subject: chemistry
content: The degree of dissociation of calcium nitrate in a dilute aqueous solution, containing 7.0 g. of the salt per 100 gm of water at 100<sup>o</sup>C is 70%. If the vapour pressure of water at 100<sup>o</sup>C is 760 mm, calculate the vapour pressure of the solution.
